protocol.tape: Regenerate lower_run.py single64 draw with seed [20261112,int(date),query,decision], unchanged full posterior and templates; no new confirmation worlds.
protocol.fixed: Same four saved tails, original prefix prepended, rescue index shifted by prefix length, every frozen nominal departure retained.
protocol.adaptive: Execute original prefix, then use saved exact arrival-phase choice through BoundaryRecoursePlan.tail_for. No policy regeneration or posterior re-evaluation.
protocol.hindsight: Minimum realized committed loss among the same four full policies, selected after seeing the complete world.
protocol.oracle: Full temporal station-MCT scan on the same packed world; its mean must reproduce the saved lower run.
protocol.inference: Paired Monte Carlo standard errors on the reused64 IID worlds; exact saved analytic expectations shown where available. No new confidence certificate.
protocol.interpretation: First two components need not be nonnegative in each world. Last component includes frozen family, prefix, commitment and temporal-relaxation differences; neither it nor family hindsight is the full causal optimum.
